ACCOUNT LAB / DISCOVERY & QUALIFICATION

Better accounts.
Better conversations.

Explore 200 fictional companies or qualify a list you already own.

Local processing only
This lab scores supplied information; it does not discover or verify live companies. A fit score is a prioritisation aid, not evidence of buying intent.

CSV format & scoring explained

Required: company. Optional: domain,industry,country,employees,signal,buyer,source. Use the dropdown spellings for market and industry, and whole numbers for headcount. Maximum 1 MB / 5,000 rows. Duplicate domains (or names without a domain) are removed. Imports replace the displayed list and remain in memory until refresh.

Industry 35 + market 20 + headcount 25 + presence of a supplied signal 20 = 100. “All” gives the full weight for that criterion. Signal text is not verified. Missing or mismatched fields score zero. Fictional data never counts as research evidence.

THE 200-COMPANY WORKFLOW

A research run should end with evidence.
Not just 200 rows.

Approved ICP → collect permitted sources → deduplicate → enrich with source dates → qualify → verify exceptions → sales review → export accepted accounts.

Track requested, found, qualified, rejected and unresolved counts separately. If only 137 accounts qualify, report 137. Never pad the list to hit a quota.

Explore the qualification step →

The review rhythm

DAILY

Execution health

What completed, what is pending, why it is blocked and who owns the next step.

WEEKLY

Growth learning

Qualified conversations, funnel movement, experiments and evidence that changes the plan.

MONTHLY

Business outcomes

Pipeline, acquisition efficiency, adoption and retention against the agreed baseline.
